messages:
Elaine: FYI I uploaded the new price sheet (v3) and an initial cohort mapping. Planning to start an A/B rollout next Mon morning. Link: https://g.co/redwood/pricing-v3 (gdoc). Need decisions on grandfathering exceptions.
Sam: can you confirm the success metrics for the A/B? is it revenue uplift or retention delta?
Elaine: priority is 1) no invoice surprises, 2) <5% net revenue delta vs control in week 1, 3) conversion on paid trials.
Raj: for billing, we need the cohort export by EOD Fri. Also need a clear rule for metering deltas so we don't double-bill during cutover.
Marco: agree on export. I'll run a canary set of 200 accounts under Dedicated to validate invoice shapes. We should also have a rollback tag on accounts.
Olivia: Legal flagged customers with legacy addenda — we need explicit notice for any changes to per-token pricing. Suggest grandfather window rather than silent adjust.
Elaine: proposal: grandfather all customers with committed/reserved contracts that started before 2025-01-01 until 2026-12-31, no changes to invoice lines. All others go into A/B. Thoughts?
Sam: sounds reasonable but want a smaller control for high-usage SKUs. Can we stratify by 3 buckets: low/med/high usage?
Raj: yes. Also: for high-usage, run a parallel metering job to compute the delta column so finance can reconcile. I can provide a script:
```
# sample reconciliation query
SELECT customer_id, invoice_period, old_units, new_units, (new_units-old_units) as delta
FROM billing_summary
WHERE invoice_period = '2026-03'
```
Marco: for the canary, I'll pick 50 low+50 med+100 high across regions. Need the exact cohort CSV by EOD.
Elaine: attaching sample cohort CSV to the doc. Quick snippet:
```csv
customer_id,cohort,grandfather_until,ab_group
cust_0123,legacy,2026-12-31,B
cust_4567,trial,,A
cust_9988,high_usage,,B
```

Olivia: add a line in the notice: "No change to committed terms for customers in the legacy cohort until the stated grandfather date." I'll draft the short amendment.
Sam: communications: growth will send the in-product banner + email to affected customers. Need final copy by Fri 1pm. @Olivia can you review tone?
Olivia: yes, will review. Also confirm opt-out mechanics (support form vs self-serve flag).
Raj: implement support flag — I'll add a boolean tag `pricing_cutover_exempt` to billing objects. Support can flip it.
Marco: ops checklist: canary, export sanity, reconciliation job, banner staged, rollback runbook. I'll create a short runbook in the doc and link the war-room channel.
Elaine: decision log: grandfather window = customers with reserved/committed contracts started before 2025-01-01 until 2026-12-31; A/B target split 30% control / 70% variant; canary cohort 200 accounts. Alex from support to be pager for cutover day.
Sam: noted. Any blockers?
Raj: one blocker: historical usage mapping for two customers with consolidated billing. I'll DM details.
billing-bot: File uploaded: pricing-v3-cohort-mapping.csv (uploaded by Elaine) :file_folder:
Elaine: thanks all — please drop any final exceptions into the sheet and I'll lock the cohort at 5pm Fri. :thumbsup:
Sam: ack :eyes:
